dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please forgive me. I meant no harm to your dignity.

dialogues.speaker: Pauper
dialogues.text: (The cat does not answer. Perhaps out of anger, wounded pride, or a sense of insult. Not a lack of morality, but a very human reaction.)

dialogues.speaker: Pauper
dialogues.text: (Or perhaps simply because it is only a cat.)
